subject.title: fix(release): run regular publish from trusted main

question: Should normal beta and stable publication now require protected-main orchestration, removing release-branch dispatch as a supported operator path?
rationale: The implementation is coherent security hardening, but it deliberately changes a live release-operator contract and needs explicit release-owner acceptance.

options.title: Require protected main
options.body: Refresh and land this change so regular publication always executes current protected-main workflow bytes while candidate data remains immutable.

options.title: Keep release-branch dispatch
options.body: Retain the existing operator path and accept that stale release-branch workflow bytes can bypass newer orchestration validation.

recommendation.title: Require protected main
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this change so regular publication always executes current protected-main workflow bytes while candidate data remains immutable.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the immediately preceding immutable-evidence release-safety change and are the strongest available owner for the resulting publication contract.
